description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output with a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale with tick marks from 0 to 20 at intervals of 5, though the data extends slightly past 20. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three lines. The blue dashed line, representing "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, drops to near 0.0 by layer 2, and remains steady near 0.0 through the end of the x-axis. The orange dotted line, representing "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", starts at approximately 1.0 at layer 0, exhibits a downward trend to around 0.2 at layer 15, and then fluctuates, ending near 0.4. The green dash-dot line, representing "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", starts at approximately 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.1 by layer 15, and remains relatively steady, ending near 0.1.
